note: Tree type 2 (TREES-DEPTH-56): per tree model of a layer, a billboard sprite and an eight-sided star of four oriented sprites at the angles below, both baked from the original model. Read only by the layer's test stage chim-sol-trees (tools/chim_tree_copies.py); no base stage reads this file.

star_prism.note: Route D, the maintainer's drawing (10 November 2026): a closed opaque star-footprint crown of stacked tiers on a trunk; sizes from each model's vertices (tools/chim_tree_star.py).

rally.note: The rally-game trees (SOLSTHEIM-TREES-THREE-LOD-68, the maintainer, 22 November 2026): the trunk in polygons, the crown cut from above into wedges by vertical planes through the trunk's axis, each plane one see-through picture face per side, its picture rendered from the original crown (tools/chim_tree_rally.py). planes 4 = 8 panes. pane_texture: silhouette (the whole crown seen across the plane) or slice (only the crown's triangles in that plane's wedge). trunk: original (the model's bark triangles) or prism (trunk_sides tapered bark faces). texels_per_unit: picture texels per map unit at scale 1 (lowered per model when a pane would pass the converter's 240-texel face extent). supersample: the picture is rendered this many times larger and a texel is solid where at least coverage of its samples are. outline_corners: each pane face is the convex outline of its solid texels with at most this many corners. methods: the alternative model numbers of a test image built with --chim-sol-tree-copies rally-switch, picked in game by aw_tree_crowns.
